faqsTitle: Quick answers about SecureHive Privileged Access Management.
faq1A: PAM is the set of controls that govern elevated access to critical systems and secrets — who can get admin rights, for how long, and with what oversight. SecureHive focuses on discovery, just-in-time access, vaulting, and session accountability.
faq2Q: How is SecureHive different from our identity provider?
faq2A: Your IdP handles workforce login and SSO. SecureHive governs what happens after authentication when someone needs privileged access to servers, cloud consoles, or shared credentials.
faq3Q: Can we start with a limited pilot?
faq3A: Yes. Many teams begin with discovery and vaulting of shared admin accounts, or with vendor access, then expand to JIT and session controls.
faq4Q: Does SecureHive require replacing existing tools?
faq4A: No. SecureHive is designed to work alongside enterprise directories and identity providers. Deployment is typically phased rather than rip-and-replace.
